purpose: Verify local checked phase and bound root capture through actual native CLI generation, replay, restricted report and export.

inputs.cell_order: solver fastest, twist, arity, key, generator, curve seed, field size, family slowest; singleton axes leave binary n11 false/true, binary n12 false/true, koblitz n11 false/true, koblitz n12 false/true

acceptance: clean binary source identity and immutable binary hash before and after each command
eight fixed cells cover every requested family/field/twist combination exactly once and each retains one binary root certificate
native dataset verify succeeds with semantic replay (not hashes-only)
export retains restricted certificates and representative certificate/private payload keys are absent from public features
four checked phase starts and four metrics per selected cell; unavailable counters allowed
capture binding and limits admitted by native replay
eight restricted report rows per cell; no whole-worker or training-cost claim
no phase measurements enter public feature objects

controls.positive: fixed natural seed42 targets; no planted PDP target, success requirement, resampling or adaptation after draw
controls.negative: separate source-bound Rust tests reject malformed and rehashed certificate/outcome/artifact tampering
controls.aa: not applicable: exact software assertions, no timing or statistical comparison

stopping: any command or assertion failure stops fixture and retains all outputs; no automatic retry or substitution. Parent invokes bash script with an outer timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=10s 1800s; internal commands use min(45 seconds, remaining 1800-second allowance).
design_notes: 42 commands: plan/preflight and generate/verify/status/export/report for each of eight fixed cells; 54 commands across both protocols.
analysis: Exact software validation of this combined source only. Preserve every outcome, verify retained root artifacts and restricted export. No timing comparison, scientific corpus, broad parameter coverage, or mathematical claim.

output_storage.fixed: existing canonical parent under /var/tmp on XFS
output_storage.check: stat -f -c %T must equal xfs before output creation and again afterward
output_storage.publication: Parent archives all completed or failed outputs to S3; runner performs no publication

variable_ledger.resource_limits: unchanged: 20 seconds per case, 45 seconds per command, 512 MiB, 16 MiB polled trace, 1800 seconds total, zero retries
variable_ledger.binary: Bind exact final validated source and executable hash before freezing; no execution while draft.

amendment.reason: New checked local producer path; same fixed inputs and finite limits; add report/scope/retention checks, no retries.
